sections.title: Study path
sections.intro: Start from the map: each tile is a module, and its bar fills as you tick steps. The steps follow a suggested order, from the first tools to the pitfalls of recent versions.

sections.title: Reference by tool
sections.intro: Every entry belongs to a tool and a group and has a level. Many entries have a "Try it" box: slice a text, step through code line by line, or predict a result before you see it. Use the filters to narrow the list, or follow the study path.

sections.title: Common errors
sections.intro: Changes in recent pandas and seaborn versions that break older code. Each entry shows the code, its real output on the pinned versions, and the fix.

sections.title: Common Challenges in Data Analysis
sections.intro: Questions analysts run into in everyday work, grouped by theme. The selection is editorial, drawn from industry surveys and common pandas problems listed in the sources of each entry; it is not a ranked list.
